description: National greenhouse gas emissions of the six GCC states by year: Climate TRACE by sector (power, fossil-fuel-operations, manufacturing and others; MtCO2e, 100-year basis), the Climate Watch historical series by sector, and Our World in Data per-person and intensity indicators. Every row names its source; the methods differ, so never add one source to another. National aggregates only.

title: GCC greenhouse gas emissions (Climate TRACE, Climate Watch, OWID)
